summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host recon and AWS Lambda identifiers to webhook.site
details: The package's `preinstall` lifecycle hook runs `probe.js`, which on `npm install` collects host reconnaissance from the installer (a listing of /tmp, /proc/uptime, and AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME / AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_STREAM_NAME values read from /proc/2/environ) and POSTs the JSON payload over HTTPS to a hardcoded webhook.site collector at https://webhook.site/5711fe0a-6437-47ae-9fd0-75d624c26467/shared5. Reading another process's environment via /proc/2/environ is targeted identification of AWS Lambda / serverless build environments. The behavior fires automatically at install time without any caller opt-in and the destination is an author-controlled collector unrelated to any documented package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
